notes.disengage: Vault's blind + leap-off and Blinding Assault blind disrupt divers

notes.high_mobility: W Grand Entrance dashes to a location, E Battle Dance flies to an allied champion and can be re-cast for free, and R The Quickness grants Move Speed; repeated dashes/movement tools.
notes.hard_engage: W Grand Entrance dashes in and knocks up nearby enemies on arrival, a reliable fight-starting lockdown; R The Quickness charms enemies touched.
notes.team_heal_shield: Q Gleaming Quill heals allies after hitting a champion/epic monster, and E Battle Dance shields the allied champion he flies to.

notes.anti_ad: Passive grants bonus AD scaling with Armor and MR; W Defensive Ball Curl vastly increases Armor/MR and returns damage to enemies that attack him, blunting auto-attackers.
notes.hard_engage: Q Powerball accelerates into enemies dealing damage and slowing to start a fight, combining with E taunt.
notes.point_click_cc: E Frenzying Taunt is a targeted taunt that forces a chosen enemy champion into a reckless assault.

notes.healing_dependent: Passive Fury is consumed while Burrowed to restore health — her core sustain mechanic.
notes.hard_engage: Unburrow knocks up and damages nearby enemies — a reliable AoE knock-up lockdown to start fights.
notes.anti_tank: Void Rush (R) lunges at a marked target for heavy damage based on their MAXIMUM health, scaling against tanks.

notes.anti_ad: Passive steals Armor and Magic Resist on hit, stripping enemy armor (reduces enemy AD-mitigation and physical durability).
notes.hard_engage: W Ferromancy crashes down knocking enemies up while mounting/dismounting; R Magnet Storm violently pulls nearby enemies toward her, reliable AoE fight-starting lockdown.

notes.pick_potential: Q Handshake roots the first enemy hit and can recast to throw the unit in a direction, isolating a target.
notes.team_heal_shield: W Bailout buffs an ally and delays their death (saving them on a takedown), and E Loyalty Program shields allies hit.

notes.hard_engage: Ruthless Predator stuns the target (1.5s when empowered) and Slice and Dice dashes in — reliable point-blank stun lockdown to commit a fight.
notes.healing_dependent: Cull the Meek heals for a portion of damage dealt (increased above 50 Fury) — sustain bruiser.
notes.anti_ad: Empowered Slice and Dice reduces the Armor of units hit (armor shred).
notes.scaling_early: Fury-fueled early lane dominance that tapers off late (classic early-game bully).

notes.anti_ad: Thrill of the Hunt's leap onto the tracked enemy reduces their armor, blunting their durability against physical damage.
notes.pick_potential: Thrill of the Hunt Camouflages him, reveals the nearest enemy champion, and lets him leap to that tracked target from range, built to single out and delete an isolated target.
notes.self_peel: Battle Roar's Ferocity effect breaks crowd control effects on him, letting him shrug off lockdown during a dive.
Valor steps forward and blocks incoming damage (a shield); Broken Wings' third cast knocks back nearby enemies.
notes.disengage: Broken Wings third activation knocks back nearby enemies, creating space to disengage; Valor's dash + shield aids escape.
notes.skillshot_reliant: Ki Burst and Wind Slash (R) are skillshots/AoE that must be aimed to land the stun and execute damage.

notes.self_peel: Scrap Shield grants a shield and a burst of speed (increased in Danger Zone).
notes.disengage: The Equalizer (R) lays a wall of flames that slows and damages, zoning enemies off to disengage; Electro Harpoon slows.
notes.lane_poke: Electro Harpoon is a ranged poke that slows and shreds Magic Resist; Flamespitter pokes in a cone.
notes.waveclear: Flamespitter torches a cone over 3 seconds, strong waveclear.

notes.deals_magic: Passive adds bonus magic damage on melee-range attacks
notes.high_mobility: Wild Rush dashes through enemies and resets on champion kill
notes.self_peel: Blade Whirl destroys incoming missiles and Wild Rush dashes away from danger
notes.projectile_block: Blade Whirl destroys enemy missiles in an area around her, windwall-style
notes.scaling_mid: Snowbally skirmisher, strong across mid-game once items come online

notes.hard_engage: Q Arctic Assault charges forward knocking enemies into the air; R Glacial Prison throws a bola that freezes and stuns the first champion hit to start a fight.
notes.cc_immunity: Passive Frost Armor grants immunity to slows while active.

notes.lane_poke: Piercing Darkness is a long-range beam that damages enemies through a target
notes.team_heal_shield: Piercing Darkness heals allies it passes through; Dawning Shadow shields allies globally
notes.self_peel: Last Embrace root + Curse of the Black Mist makes her unselectable and camouflaged to escape
notes.pick_potential: Dawning Shadow fires a global beam across the map damaging enemies and shielding allies
notes.scaling_late: Mist-stacking scaler — very weak AD early, becomes a long-range crit carry late

notes.team_heal_shield: W Surround Sound shields and hastes nearby allies, and additionally heals nearby allies if she is already shielded.
notes.disengage: E Beat Drop impairs movement (slow/root) of enemies in a line and R Encore charms enemies hit, both creating space to break off.
notes.lane_poke: Q High Note deals ranged area damage and passive grants bonus magic damage and range on her next attack, supporting safe poke.

notes.hard_engage: Facebreaker pulls in enemies on opposite sides and stuns them; The Show Stopper (R) carries and slams an enemy champion, slowing nearby enemies — reliable lockdown engage.
notes.self_peel: Haymaker stores damage taken as Grit and converts it into a shield on cast.
notes.anti_tank: Knuckle Down's next two attacks deal additional damage based on the target's MAX health; Haymaker center deals true damage — both scale against / ignore the resists of durable targets.

notes.pick_potential: Deceive teleports him invisibly to a location with an empowered crit attack from behind, and Jack In The Box fears enemies, letting him ambush and delete an isolated target.

notes.anti_tank: Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on the target's max health.
notes.team_heal_shield: R Stand United shields a target allied champion from incoming damage then teleports to them.

notes.hard_engage: Dragon's Descent (R) transforms and leaps forward causing enemies along the path to flee — a reliable long-range fear engage.
notes.waveclear: Emberstrike hits the target plus surrounding area and Molten Burst explodes on large targets, giving strong AoE clear.

notes.anti_tank: Passive (post-death reanimation) attacks deal bonus damage based on the target's maximum Health.
notes.anti_ad: E Roar of the Slayer reduces the Armor of enemies hit, stripping physical durability.
notes.hard_engage: R Unstoppable Onslaught charges across the map, knocking up enemies on collision based on distance charged; Q Decimating Smash knocks up and stuns if fully charged, both fight-starting.

notes.waveclear: Boomerang Blade + Ricochet bounces clear entire waves extremely fast
notes.self_peel: Spell Shield blocks a single enemy ability cast on her and grants health + move speed
notes.lane_poke: Boomerang Blade is a long ranged poke that damages both ways

notes.anti_tank: Passive Quaking deals max Health magic damage over its duration at max stacks.
notes.hard_engage: E Ixtal's Impact charges through terrain, slamming a collided champion into the next wall to stun, opening the fight; R Impale suppresses and drags.
notes.pick_potential: R Impale suppresses enemy champions and drags the victims along as Skarner moves, isolating a target.
notes.point_click_cc: R Impale is a targeted suppression that locks down chosen enemies and drags them.

notes.deals_magic: Super Scorcher Breath and his fire abilities deal magic damage
notes.lane_poke: Achooo! is a ranged poke that explodes on champions
notes.high_mobility: Flap, Flap, Flap takes flight ignoring terrain to reposition
notes.self_peel: Flap, Flap, Flap flies over terrain to escape dives
notes.waveclear: Super Scorcher Breath + Achooo! + MMOOOMMMM! clear waves with AoE fire
notes.scaling_late: Stack-based scaler (Dragon Practice) — weak early, ramps into a hypercarry

notes.team_heal_shield: W Aria of Perseverance heals Sona and a nearby wounded ally and grants tagged allies a shield aura.
notes.disengage: E Song of Celerity grants nearby allies bonus Move Speed and R Crescendo stuns enemy champions, both enabling escape/peel.
notes.lane_poke: Q Hymn of Valor sends bolts dealing magic damage to nearby enemies, a repeatable ranged poke tool.

notes.team_heal_shield: W Astral Infusion + R Wish keep the whole team topped up

notes.healing_dependent: Passive Soul Fragments heal him and raise max health; Demonic Ascension drains health from nearby enemies to sustain.
notes.frontline: Permanent max-health growth from Soul Fragments plus draining ult lets him hold the front.
notes.self_peel: Nevermove roots and can pull enemies, and Demonic Ascension's drain sustains him through a dive.

notes.high_mobility: Abscond dashes to a location and Abduct recasts to pull himself to an enemy he hits.
notes.healing_dependent: Kingslayer heals him when used against enemy champions, his core sustain.
notes.hard_engage: Abduct pulls himself to an enemy, and a hijacked engage ult lets him start fights.
notes.self_peel: Abscond dash plus Kingslayer self-heal let him survive and escape a dive.

notes.pick_potential: Unleashed Power bombards a single enemy champion with all her spheres for long-range single-target burst (and executes low-health targets per passive).

notes.disengage: R Devour can swallow an ally to remove them from harm (shielding them); Thick Skin converts stored damage into a shield, both protective peel.
notes.team_heal_shield: R Devour shields a targeted ally champion while they are devoured.

notes.disengage: Weaver's Wall creates a very long wall to block and split pursuers; Seismic Shove throws enemies away.

notes.pick_potential: Noxian Diplomacy leaps to and stabs (crit in melee) a target with health/cooldown refund on kill; his passive Wound stacks then bleed for heavy damage, built to close on and delete an isolated target.
notes.self_peel: Shadow Assault makes him Invisible with bonus Move Speed, and Assassin's Path vaults over any terrain on a low cooldown, both usable to escape a dive.

notes.team_heal_shield: Q Starlight's Touch heals nearby allied champions and W Bastion shields an ally plus passively grants Armor to Taric and the Bastion ally.

notes.deals_magic: Toxic Shot poison on-hit and Blinding Dart deal magic damage; AP-scaling DoT carry
notes.lane_poke: Auto + Toxic Shot poison and Blinding Dart give strong ranged lane harass
notes.self_peel: Move Quick (passive invisibility when still/in brush + sprint) and Noxious Trap slows let him escape dives
notes.scaling_early: Strong early lane bully whose relative power fades into the late game

notes.pick_potential: Q Death Sentence hooks a target from screens away
notes.disengage: W lantern peels an ally out + E Flay knocks divers back

notes.burst: Explosive Charge bomb + Buster Shot detonation delivers a heavy burst combo
notes.high_mobility: Rocket Jump leaps a long distance and its cooldown resets on kills/Explosive Charge
notes.self_peel: Rocket Jump escapes dives; Buster Shot knocks an attacker back off her
notes.disengage: Buster Shot knocks a target back to break up a dive or fight
notes.scaling_late: Range-grows-with-level hypercarry, weak early, strong late
notes.waveclear: Explosive Charge AoE on kill clears waves

notes.healing_dependent: Passive heals for a percent of nearby dying units' max health; Frozen Domain increases healing from all sources — sustain pillar.
notes.disengage: Pillar of Ice creates impassable terrain that walls off and slows enemies, a strong peel/disengage tool.
notes.anti_ad: Chomp saps some of the target's Attack Damage (reduces their AD output).
notes.anti_tank: Subjugate (R) steals a percent of the target's Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance (doubling over 4s) — %-stat steal that directly shreds a tank's durability.

notes.deals_magic: Wild Cards, Pick a Card, and Stacked Deck deal magic damage; AP carry
notes.burst: Gold Card stun + Wild Cards + Stacked Deck is a quick burst combo, not auto DPS
notes.lane_poke: Wild Cards throws three cards as ranged poke
notes.waveclear: Wild Cards pierces through multiple minions to clear waves
notes.pick_potential: Destiny reveals all enemy champions globally and teleports him onto an isolated target via Gate
notes.hard_engage: Destiny's global reveal + Gate teleport + Gold Card lets him initiate fights from across the map

notes.deals_magic: Venom Cask and Contaminate deal magic damage on poisoned targets
notes.anti_tank: Passive basic attacks apply Deadly Venom dealing true damage each second, bypassing armor on tanks
notes.lane_poke: Venom Cask + Contaminate provide ranged poke on stacked targets
notes.self_peel: Ambush grants camouflage and move speed to escape or avoid dives
notes.scaling_late: Spray and Pray late-game piercing AoE hypercarry; very weak when caught early

notes.self_peel: Iron Mantle grants a shield and healing on his next attacks (bigger on recast).
notes.healing_dependent: Iron Mantle heals him on his next attacks and over time (recast), his core sustain stance.
notes.hard_engage: Blazing Stampede gains move speed and his first attack on each target STUNS them — a reliable run-down lockdown engage.
notes.cc_immunity: Blazing Stampede recast grants immunity to immobilizing effects for a couple seconds.

notes.self_peel: Disdain charges in a direction shielding himself and hurls a caught enemy champion aside.
notes.hard_engage: Fear Beyond Death (R) chem-drill impales the first enemy champion hit (locks them) and can execute; Disdain catches and displaces a champion — reliable lockdown engage.
notes.lane_poke: Corrosive Charge is a ranged explosive that pokes and slows at a target location; 350 attack range supports auto-poke.

notes.deals_magic: Blighted Quiver and ability detonations deal magic damage; on-hit/AP builds viable
notes.lane_poke: Piercing Arrow is a long-range charged poke
notes.anti_tank: Blighted Quiver detonates Blight stacks dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum health, shredding tanks
notes.pick_potential: Chain of Corruption is a long-range immobilize that spreads to nearby champions to lock down a target
notes.disengage: Hail of Arrows desecrated ground slows and reduces enemy healing to zone/peel

notes.anti_tank: W Silver Bolts — every 3rd hit deals % max-HP true damage, melting tanks

notes.disengage: Event Horizon creates a cage that stuns enemies passing through, a defensive zone to peel chasers.

notes.anti_tank: Passive Organic Deconstruction bursts true damage at 3 stacks, and Life Form Disintegration Ray converts to true damage on researched champions, ignoring tank resistances.

notes.self_peel: Personal Space grants a shield and damages nearby enemies, plus the passive fear interrupts dashes to deter a dive.
notes.pick_potential: Shadow Surge marks an enemy champion then recasts to dash in and deal damage, catching an isolated target.

notes.self_peel: Passive charges a shield over time that activates by hitting an enemy with an ability.
notes.hard_engage: Cease and Desist (R) runs down a single enemy, knocking aside others, then knocks the target up and slams them down — an unstoppable point-and-click lockdown; Vault Breaker knocks back.
notes.anti_ad: Denting Blows breaks the opponent's Armor (armor shred), reducing tank/AD durability.

notes.healing_dependent: Passive seizes slain enemies and heals for a percentage of the target's max health; Blade of the Ruined King steals health on-hit — drain sustain.
notes.pick_potential: Heartbreaker (R) teleports and executes an enemy champion, knocking away their allies — a single-target assassination/catch on a low-health target.
notes.anti_tank: Blade of the Ruined King passive deals bonus percent CURRENT-health damage on-hit, scaling against high-health targets (current-health, not missing-health).

notes.self_peel: Siphon Power grants a shield (and bonus move speed when augmented) to absorb a dive's burst.

notes.healing_dependent: Transfusion steals life and Sanguine Pool siphons life; his whole kit is drain-based sustain.
notes.self_peel: Sanguine Pool makes him untargetable for 2 seconds, escaping a dive.

notes.healing_dependent: Frenzied Maul's repeat-cast on a marked target heals Volibear — sustain mechanic.
notes.hard_engage: Thundering Smash gains speed toward enemies and STUNS the first one he attacks; Stormbringer (R) leaps and slows enemies beneath while disabling nearby towers — reliable lockdown dive engage.

notes.healing_dependent: Passive heals equal to bonus magic damage below 50% health (tripled below 25%); Jaws of the Beast heals for damage dealt — core drain sustain.
notes.hard_engage: Infinite Duress (R) leaps and suppresses the first champion collided with for 1.5s — a reliable lockdown engage; Blood Hunt grants chase speed.
notes.point_click_cc: Infinite Duress suppresses the target for 1.5s once it connects (a hard, cleanse-resistant lockdown).
notes.anti_tank: Jaws of the Beast deals damage based on the target's MAXIMUM health, scaling against high-health tanks.

notes.hard_engage: Cyclone (R) spins and knocks up enemies struck while gaining move speed — a reliable AoE knock-up lockdown to start fights.
notes.anti_ad: Crushing Blow reduces the target's armor for a few seconds (armor shred); passive also stacks armor for himself, blunting incoming AD.

notes.lane_poke: Double Daggers throws two daggers as ranged harass that drop recallable Feathers
notes.self_peel: Featherstorm leaps into the air becoming untargetable, dodging dives entirely
notes.disengage: Bladecaller recalls Feathers to root pursuing enemies
notes.waveclear: Post-ability attacks hit all targets along their path plus Double Daggers clear waves

notes.pick_potential: Rite of the Arcane fires numerous long-range barrages that, combined with Shocking Orb's stun, catch and burst an isolated target from afar.

notes.healing_dependent: Passive third attack heals Xin Zhao — skirmish sustain.
notes.hard_engage: Audacious Charge dashes to an enemy (slowing/AoE) and Three Talon Strike's third hit knocks up — reliable point-blank lockdown engage.
notes.self_peel: Crescent Guard (R) knocks back non-challenged targets and makes him impervious to damage from champions outside the circle — strong anti-dive self-peel.
notes.anti_tank: Crescent Guard (R) deals damage to nearby enemies based on their CURRENT Health, scaling against high-health targets (current-health, not missing).

notes.projectile_block: W Wind Wall destroys all enemy projectiles in a wide arc

notes.self_peel: Spirit Cleave grants a shield scaling with the number of champions hit.
notes.hard_engage: Fate Sealed (R) blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls all enemies hit toward him; Mortal Steel's 2-stack dash knocks enemies airborne — reliable lockdown engage.
notes.skillshot_reliant: Mortal Steel and Fate Sealed are directional skillshots that must land to apply their airborne/pull effects.

notes.healing_dependent: Last Rites heals himself on the empowered attack — light sustain.
notes.disengage: Dark Procession summons a destructible wall that blocks enemy movement, a zoning/peel/disengage tool.
notes.anti_ad: Mourning Mist reduces the target's armor (armor shred), exposing them to physical damage.
notes.waveclear: Mist Walkers (passive) and Last Rites grave-digging let him swarm and clear waves with summoned units.

notes.deals_magic: Passive crits deal bonus magic damage and Arc of Judgment deals damage; hybrid output
notes.lane_poke: Arc of Judgment fires a spinning bead that damages and slows at range
notes.high_mobility: Kanmei's Steps grants move speed/ghosting and becomes a dash in Transcendent State
notes.self_peel: Kanmei's Steps move speed + ghost/dash lets her escape dives

notes.team_heal_shield: Passive restores health to the next ally she attaches to, E Zoomies passes shield/Move Speed/Attack Speed to her ally when attached, and R Final Chapter heals allies.

notes.healing_dependent: The Darkin Glaive heals himself on its slashes and Grim Deliverance (R) heals for a portion of the damage dealt — drain-style Darkin sustain.
notes.hard_engage: Dreaded Return stabs then PULLS enemies toward him; The Darkin Glaive recast knocks up the target — reliable lockdown engage.

notes.anti_tank: W Unstable Matter deals a percentage of the enemy's maximum health as magic damage.
notes.hard_engage: E Elastic Slingshot launches him across a distance into the enemy; R Let's Bounce bounces four times knocking up and slowing enemies, reliable long-range fight-starting engage.

notes.burst: shadow combo + R Death Mark one-shots a marked carry

notes.deals_magic: Passive: her attacks deal magic damage and are treated as abilities
notes.lane_poke: Ultrashock Laser is a long-range slowing poke that expands into a laser off walls
notes.high_mobility: Spark Surge dashes and vaults/grinds over terrain, very high repositioning
notes.self_peel: Spark Surge dashes over walls to escape dives; Lightning Crash stacks move speed
notes.scaling_late: Energy-stacking hypercarry, weak early, scales hard into the late game

notes.disengage: Satchel Charge detonates to knock enemies away (and self-knockback to reposition), peeling fights apart.

notes.team_heal_shield: R Chronoshift places a time rune on an ally that teleports them back in time (resurrecting) if they take lethal damage.
notes.disengage: E Time Warp increases an ally's Move Speed (or slows an enemy) to enable escape; Q Time Bomb stun (when a bomb detonates another) adds peel.

notes.pick_potential: A long-range Paddle Star that deals more the farther it flies, set up by Sleepy Trouble Bubble's sleep, one-shots an isolated target.
notes.self_peel: Portal Jump blinks her away for 1 second then back, dodging a dive's burst.

notes.disengage: Stranglethorns knocks all enemies airborne as it contracts, a wide AoE that peels chasers and breaks up an engage.
